name: JWT boundary negative and positive controls
description: Hardened Cognito-only tests. Missing/malformed JWTs are rejected with 401; a signature-tampered JWT is rejected at the API Gateway boundary (403 in this lab); a genuine Cognito ID token should reach the application and return 200. All requests include the explicit internal-source LAB simulation so the positive test is not rejected by the separate Lambda source-IP checkpoint. No token strings are stored.
